name: app-store-compliance
description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 117 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 95 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A checklist and automated guard that catches the exact mistakes that get mobile apps rejected from the App Store and Google Play, before you submit.
buyer: An indie mobile app developer or small app studio who has lost days to review-rejection cycles or missed a privacy-law deadline.
business_use_cases: A solo app developer runs it before every submission to avoid losing days to App Store or Play Store rejection cycles.
A mobile dev agency sells 'App Store compliance audit' as a paid pre-launch service for client apps.
A compliance-minded consultant builds a subscription alert service around its tracked regulatory deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA) for app publishers.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a flat-fee pre-submission compliance audit per app.
Run a subscription alert service that tracks upcoming app-store and privacy-law deadlines for publishers.

steal_this: Offer a flat $99 'pre-submission compliance check' service to indie app developers on Reddit and Twitter this week.
